name: Wavelet-based Adaptive Resolution Volume Rendering
definition: A rendering technique that stores reconstructed data at pre-selected wavelet tree nodes based on available storage to reduce reconstruction cost, then traverses the tree per error tolerance to decompress and render blocks in parallel.
summary: Wavelet-based Adaptive Resolution Volume Rendering is a parallel technique that reduces reconstruction cost by storing data at pre-selected wavelet nodes and traversing the tree based on error tolerance to render varying resolution blocks.
